nf38d62f3fcb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the distributional effects of inflation?
o: Debtors may gain as the real value of repayment falls
Creditors may lose as money received buys less
Fixed-income groups such as pensioners are automatically protected
Holders of real assets may gain from rising prices
nf38d62f3fcb.x: Fixed-income groups are generally vulnerable to inflation unless their incomes are adjusted; debtors and real-asset holders may gain while creditors may lose.

n9de3b0a4505.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about supply-side measures against food inflation?
o: NCCF and NAFED released onion from the Price Stabilisation Fund buffer
Bharat Atta, Rice and Dal are sold through NAFED, NCCF and Kendriya Bhandar
Pulses and onions are held in the Price Stabilisation Fund buffer
Under OMSS (Domestic), FCI sells pulses and onions at fixed prices
n9de3b0a4505.x: Under OMSS, FCI sells wheat and rice; pulses and onions belong to the PSF buffer.

nae0ed7fe1df.s: According to Friedman, the long-run Phillips curve is:
nae0ed7fe1df.x: Friedman held the long-run Phillips curve to be vertical, implying no lasting trade-off between inflation and unemployment.

n45fade5dd9d.s: How many items does the new WPI series contain?
n45fade5dd9d.x: The new WPI series has 957 items, against 697 in the earlier series; its weights are based on Gross Value of Output.

n9893f16b287.s: Which of the following generally mitigates, rather than causes, supply-side inflation in India?
n9893f16b287.x: Monsoon failure, El Nino, costlier crude and rupee depreciation create supply shocks; better storage and distribution efficiency eases them.

n053a39b682b.s: Stagflation refers to inflation accompanied by:
o: Slow growth and falling industrial output
A sustained rise in productive capacity
n053a39b682b.x: Stagflation is inflation combined with falling industrial output and slow growth; higher government spending can add the inflationary pressure.

n6de20273884.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the State-level Price Monitoring Committee is headed by the:
n6de20273884.x: The Chief Secretary heads AP's State-level Price Monitoring Committee; the DES monitors 8 essential commodities daily.

ne23c78cea5e.s: Inflation returning after a period of deflation, seen as a sign of recovery, is called:
ne23c78cea5e.x: Reflation is inflation returning after deflation; a falling but positive inflation rate is disinflation.

nindian-economy-51-5.s: Inflation accompanied by slow growth and unemployment is called:
nindian-economy-51-5.x: Stagflation combines inflation with slow growth and unemployment.

n04acf0e693c.s: Which of the following would generally reduce cost-push inflationary pressure in India?
o: A permanent fall in input costs
n04acf0e693c.x: A fall in input costs reduces cost-push pressure, whereas hoarding, MSP increases and inflation expectations add to inflation.

nda9942020ee.s: Core inflation generally excludes the prices of:
nda9942020ee.x: Core inflation excludes volatile food and fuel prices to show the underlying, demand-side trend.

ncb7a711fd72.s: Which group carries the largest weight (about 64%) in WPI?
ncb7a711fd72.x: Manufactured products carry about 64% weight in WPI, which covers goods only.

n65a4ac589a9.s: India's CPI inflation in 2025 was 2.2%, a ____ low.
n65a4ac589a9.x: CPI inflation of 2.2% in 2025 was a 12-year low.

n73f43073681.s: The main limitation of the repo rate in controlling inflation is that it:
o: Acts only on the supply side
Can be changed only by the Union Government
Cannot directly resolve supply shocks such as onion or crude-oil price spikes
n73f43073681.x: The repo rate works on aggregate demand and liquidity, so it cannot directly remove supply shocks like onion or crude-oil price rises.

na79eb6c731a.s: Under the RBI Act, 1934 (amended 2016), which Section requires a report when the inflation band is breached for three consecutive quarters?
na79eb6c731a.x: Section 45ZN requires the report; Section 45ZA deals with target-setting and Section 45ZB with the MPC.

n8f2f6c37195.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Parthasarathi Shome?
o: The Shome Committee (2012) dealt with GAAR
He recommended VAT at the manufacturing stage, leading to MODVAT
The Shome Committee advised scrapping retrospective tax
The Tax Administration Reform Commission (2013) was headed by him
n8f2f6c37195.x: VAT at the manufacturing stage (MODVAT) came from the L.K. Jha Committee (1976), not Shome.

nindian-economy-44-7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Wealth tax was a direct tax on net wealth, abolished in 2015
Capital gains tax is a direct tax on profit from selling a capital asset
Gift tax was a direct tax on property received without consideration
Customs duty is a direct tax on imports and exports
nindian-economy-44-7.x: Customs duty is an indirect tax on imports and exports.

n67f267bfcc2.s: The response of tax revenue to GDP, excluding discretionary changes in rates and base, is called:
n67f267bfcc2.x: Tax elasticity excludes discretionary changes, while tax buoyancy includes them.

n8a78c4d36ca.s: The World Bank regards a tax-GDP ratio of ____ as a tipping point for sustainable growth.
n8a78c4d36ca.x: The World Bank benchmark is 15 per cent; India's 2001-2022 average was 16.36 per cent.

n98351fe0b9d.s: The 80th Constitutional Amendment, 2000, on sharing Union taxes with States, took effect from:
n98351fe0b9d.x: The 80th Amendment was made in 2000 but took effect from 1 April 1996.

n5bcb41dcf26.s: Which kind of taxes is generally progressive in nature?
n5bcb41dcf26.x: Direct taxes are generally progressive, while indirect taxes may be regressive; a higher direct-tax share improves progressivity.

nb6f3f26a268.s: In which year was wealth tax introduced in India?
nb6f3f26a268.x: Wealth tax on net wealth was introduced in 1957 and abolished in 2015.

ndee9fbcd95a.s: A payment made for a specific service, involving quid pro quo, is called a:
ndee9fbcd95a.x: A fee is paid for a specific service and involves quid pro quo; a tax has no direct quid pro quo.

n77c19fb9bd5.s: Moving the burden of a tax forward to consumers or backward to suppliers is called:
n77c19fb9bd5.x: This is tax shifting; impact is on whom the tax is first imposed and incidence is on whom it finally falls.

na706f6f3395.s: Corporation tax in India is levied on:
na706f6f3395.x: The base of corporation tax is the net profit of companies.

n9162e99b81f.s: An additional charge levied on the tax payable is called a:
n9162e99b81f.x: A surcharge is an additional charge on tax payable, so none is due when no tax is due; a cess is imposed for a specific purpose.

nindian-economy-44-8.s: Which of the following is an indirect tax?
nindian-economy-44-8.x: VAT is an indirect tax passed on to buyers, like excise, service tax and sales tax.

n924f654c636.s: The tax-GDP ratio is total tax revenue divided by:
n924f654c636.x: The tax-GDP ratio uses nominal GDP; a low ratio may reflect a large informal sector or high evasion.

nindian-economy-44-5.s: A tax whose rate rises with income at first and then becomes flat is called:
nindian-economy-44-5.x: A degressive tax rate rises initially and then levels off; a proportional tax has one rate for all.

nindian-economy-44-6.s: Under a progressive tax, as income rises the average tax burden:
o: First rises and then becomes flat
nindian-economy-44-6.x: Higher income slabs are taxed at higher marginal rates, so the average tax burden increases with income.

ne3e4ff1eef6.s: A simpler tax system can raise productivity in the economy mainly by:
o: Removing deadweight costs and distortions in resource allocation
ne3e4ff1eef6.x: Simplification removes deadweight costs and reduces distortions in resource allocation, yielding productivity gains (APPSC-G1 2024).

n49e0e8738b3.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Nicholas Kaldor – Expenditure, wealth and gift taxes
Raja J. Chelliah Committee – Taxation of agricultural wealth and income
Wanchoo Committee – Black money and tax evasion
K.N. Raj – Taxation of agricultural wealth and income
n49e0e8738b3.x: The Raja Chelliah Committee focused on lower rates and a broader tax base; agricultural wealth and income was K.N. Raj's focus.

nff69e19080e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)?
o: It is the apex body for direct taxes
It is a statutory body under the Central Boards of Revenue Act, 1963
It is placed in the Department of Expenditure
It is the cadre controller of the Indian Revenue Service
nff69e19080e.x: CBDT is placed in the Department of Revenue, not the Department of Expenditure.

ncada171aad7.s:
Assertion (A): Under the new tax regime, a salaried individual pays no income tax on income up to ₹12.75 lakh.
Reason (R): The Section 87A rebate makes income up to ₹12 lakh tax-free, and a standard deduction of ₹75,000 is available.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncada171aad7.x: The ₹12 lakh rebate limit plus the ₹75,000 standard deduction gives the ₹12.75 lakh salaried threshold, so R explains A.

n629629a8b67.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: only two dated events)
n629629a8b67.s: Faceless assessment and the Taxpayers' Charter were launched on:
n629629a8b67.x: They were launched on 13 August 2020 under 'Transparent Taxation - Honouring the Honest'; faceless appeals followed in September 2020.

n9e85eb4b28f.s: Under Section 115BAB, new manufacturing companies incorporated after 1 October 2019 pay a base tax rate of:
n9e85eb4b28f.x: Section 115BAB gives a 15% rate (effective about 17.01%); Section 115BAA gives 22% (effective about 25.17%).

n9f8d8760e2e.s: India's default, exemption-free new income-tax regime is provided under Section:
n9f8d8760e2e.x: Section 115BAC provides the default exemption-free new regime; the old regime with deductions remains optional.

nbcaaad1f1c1.s: As a general rule, a capital asset held for up to ____ months is a short-term capital asset.
nbcaaad1f1c1.x: Generally, an asset held up to 24 months is short-term; rural agricultural land is not a capital asset at all.

nadfc361909d.s: The 1992 revision of wealth tax was based on the recommendations of the:
nadfc361909d.x: The Raja Chelliah Committee advocated lower rates, a broader base and fewer exemptions and formed the basis of the 1992 wealth-tax revision.

n4ad8e5805c4.s: Which body's 2004 work related to implementation of the FRBM framework and proposed a GST roadmap?
n4ad8e5805c4.x: The Kelkar Task Force covered direct and indirect taxes in 2002 and FRBM implementation with a GST roadmap in 2004.

n9063576ecd2.s: The Taxation Laws (Amendment) Act, 2019 cut the tax rate for domestic companies from 30% to:
n9063576ecd2.x: The 2019 Act cut the rate to 22% and set 15% for new manufacturing companies; MAT does not apply to those opting in.

n038d988c6c5.s: The Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Yojana (2016), introduced after demonetisation, carried a total levy of:
n038d988c6c5.x: PMGKY 2016 carried a 50% levy; the 1997 scheme was VDIS, not PMGKY.

nd2de29b546f.s: In a PAN, which character shows the holder type ('P' for individual, 'C' for company)?
nd2de29b546f.x: PAN is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier whose 4th character shows the holder type.

n94f6a63caba.s: Budget 2023-24 cut the highest surcharge under the new regime, for income above ₹2 crore, from 37% to:
n94f6a63caba.x: Budget 2023-24 reduced the highest surcharge from 37% to 25% for income above ₹2 crore under the new regime.

n2c451c235da.s: Under FAST-DS 2026, a 30% tax plus an equal additional amount gives an effective burden of:
n2c451c235da.x: 30% tax plus an equal additional amount makes 60%; the threshold is ₹1 crore, or ₹5 crore for previously taxed but unreported assets.

na66be97febf.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Union of India v. Mohit Minerals (2022)?
o: It held that the GST Council is a statutory body
It held GST Council recommendations to be persuasive, not binding
It recognised simultaneous power of Parliament and States to legislate on GST
It described India as a 'flexible federation'
na66be97febf.x: The GST Council is a constitutional body under Article 279A and was never statutory.

ne12dbf0a67b.s: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act inserted which Article relating to the GST Council?
ne12dbf0a67b.x: Article 279A provides for the GST Council; the same Amendment omitted Article 268A.

n14cfd7d42bf.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with inter-State GST?
n14cfd7d42bf.x: Article 269A concerns inter-State GST; 246A gives GST law-making power and 279A provides for the GST Council.

n975a29dd14b.s: From 1 October 2024, GST anti-profiteering cases are heard by the:
n975a29dd14b.x: Anti-profiteering functions moved from NAA to CCI in December 2022 and to the GSTAT Principal Bench from 1 October 2024.

nf1a175b9ad3.s: The Health Security se National Security Cess is levied on pan masala units on the basis of:
nf1a175b9ad3.x: It is levied on machine production capacity, and its proceeds go to the Consolidated Fund of India without being shared with States.

n92f305e161c.s: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act received Presidential assent on:
n92f305e161c.x: Presidential assent came on 8 September 2016; GST rolled out on 1 July 2017.

n026eafd7e01.s: After the general withdrawal of GST compensation cess from 22 September 2025, it continued only on:
n026eafd7e01.x: The cess was scrapped for all goods except tobacco; its levy was extended to March 2026 to repay compensation loans.

n89fa301952c.s: IGST revenue is finally settled to the:
n89fa301952c.x: GST is destination-based, so IGST revenue goes to the consuming State.

n186c2d26cda.s: GST compensation to States assumed an annual revenue growth of ____ over the 2015-16 base.
n186c2d26cda.x: Compensation was for five years at 14% annual growth over 2015-16; it ended in June 2022.

n30f320eb569.s: The Revenue Neutral Rate for GST was worked out by the committee headed by:
n30f320eb569.x: The Arvind Subramanian committee (2015) worked out the RNR, the rate that keeps revenue equal to the pre-GST level.

na4302256ea7.s: The quorum of the GST Council is:
na4302256ea7.x: The GST Council's quorum is one-half of its total members.

n42e08c955ed.s: Which of the following is outside the current GST levy?
n42e08c955ed.x: Alcoholic liquor for human consumption is outside GST, as are electricity, stamp-duty real estate transactions and ATF.

n8401247ff93.s: Which State levy was NOT subsumed in GST?
n8401247ff93.x: Stamp duty is retained outside GST; purchase, luxury and entry taxes were subsumed.

n611c21ad53a.s: An e-way bill is required for movement of goods valued above:
n611c21ad53a.x: An e-way bill is needed for goods above ₹50,000, valid one day per 200 km.

nindian-economy-15-13.s: Under GST, the Centre administers and collects:
nindian-economy-15-13.x: The Centre collects CGST and IGST, States collect SGST, and the GST Council recommends.

nindian-economy-15-8.s: GST aims to end 'tax on tax', known as the:
nindian-economy-15-8.x: Reducing cascading (tax on tax) and creating a unified national market are major GST objectives.

n6a715d86072.s: Under the GST composition scheme, the turnover limit for goods is:
n6a715d86072.x: The limit is ₹1.5 crore for goods and ₹50 lakh for services, at 1% and 6%, with no ITC.

n36d95beb0d7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT)?
o: It was created through the Finance Act, 2024
Its Principal Bench is located in Mumbai
It was formally launched in September 2025
n36d95beb0d7.x: GSTAT's Principal Bench is at New Delhi, not Mumbai.

nd38e00b9022.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about GST compliance for small businesses?
o: The composition scheme has eased the compliance burden
Automated registration has eased the compliance burden
Multiple returns and ITC matching remain a burden
The reform agenda proposes replacing pre-filled returns with manual filing
nd38e00b9022.x: The reform agenda calls for pre-filled returns, time-bound digital registration and automated exporter refunds, not manual filing.

n43a3496a961.s: With reference to Union of India v. Mohit Minerals (2022), which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: GST Council recommendations – Binding on legislatures
Source of simultaneous GST power – Article 279A
Status of GST Council – Statutory body
n43a3496a961.x: The Court called India a flexible federation; recommendations are persuasive, the simultaneous power flows from Article 246A, and the Council is constitutional.

n561b7368e2e.s: Under a multi-rate GST, placing near-identical products in different slabs mainly leads to:
n561b7368e2e.x: Differing classification of similar products invites litigation; standardising classification is a pending reform.

n04b36a3f856.s: A taxpayer under the GST composition scheme pays a flat rate of ____ on goods.
n04b36a3f856.x: The composition scheme levies 1% on goods and 6% on services, and the taxpayer cannot claim ITC.

na08415295e8.s: An e-way bill under GST is valid for one day for every:
na08415295e8.x: Validity is one day per 200 km; the e-way bill is mandatory above ₹50,000.

nfdc44859203.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about grants to States?
o: Plan grants continued after the Planning Commission was abolished in 2015
Article 275 grants are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India
Article 282 grants are criticised as bypassing the Finance Commission
nfdc44859203.x: Plan grants ended when the Planning Commission was abolished in 2015.

nace1acbe3a3.s: Grants for any public purpose chosen by the executive are associated with Article:
nace1acbe3a3.x: Article 282 covers grants for any public purpose; Article 275 grants are for States in need, ST welfare and Scheduled Areas.

nc72e5a4261a.s: Which of the following aggravates vertical fiscal imbalance between the Centre and States?
o: Removal of conditionalities on Centrally Sponsored Schemes
Cesses and surcharges kept outside the divisible pool
Retention of independent indirect taxes by States
nc72e5a4261a.x: Cesses and surcharges, loss of independent indirect taxes to GST, CSS conditionalities and weak State revenue all aggravate the imbalance.

n4053d01080a.s: The Inter-State Council under Article 263 was set up in 1990 on the recommendation of the:
n4053d01080a.x: The Union-appointed Sarkaria Commission's recommendations led to the Inter-State Council in 1990.

nd2a6e28fee9.s: The Sarkaria Commission on Centre-State relations functioned during:
nd2a6e28fee9.x: The Sarkaria Commission sat during 1983–1988; the Rajamannar Committee dates to 1969 and the Punchhi Commission to 2007–2010.

n89fee82d0f9.s: Revenue Deficit Grants to Andhra Pradesh are given under which Article of the Constitution?
n89fee82d0f9.x: AP receives Revenue Deficit Grants under Article 275, along with CSS funds, local body grants and SDLs raised through the RBI.

nd74e48526e5.s: Statutory grants-in-aid recommended by the Finance Commission are made under Article:
nd74e48526e5.x: Article 275 grants are statutory and recommended by the Finance Commission; Article 282 allows discretionary grants for any public purpose.

n597d3b8f2c2.s: The Rajamannar Committee (1969), which advocated greater State autonomy, was set up by the:
n597d3b8f2c2.x: The Tamil Nadu Government constituted the Rajamannar Committee in 1969; it argued for greater State autonomy and more resources.

n6f85745fcb9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Finance Commission grants and Andhra Pradesh?
o: 15th FC grants for 2024-25 and 2025-26 were drawn in advance by the previous government
AP said it could lose up to ₹38,000 crore after the 16th FC dropped special grants
AP's revenue deficit during 2014-19 was ₹48,000 crore
AP's projected revenue deficit for 2025-26 was ₹48,000 crore
n6f85745fcb9.x: AP's revenue deficit during 2014-19 was ₹16,000 crore; ₹48,000 crore was the projected revenue deficit for 2025-26.

nf3012ddc5cc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the devolution criteria of the 16th Finance Commission?
o: The weight of income distance was reduced to 42.5%
Contribution to GDP was added with a 10% weight
The tax and fiscal effort criterion was dropped
nf3012ddc5cc.x: The 16th FC cut the weight of area to 10%.

nf3c1a99a7de.s:
Assertion (A): The Fourth Finance Commission was chaired by P.V. Rajamannar.
Reason (R): The Eleventh Finance Commission was chaired by A.M. Khusro.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf3c1a99a7de.x: Both are true (Rajamannar chaired the 4th FC and Khusro the 11th), but they are separate facts, so R does not explain A.

nf5f4c8b11ad.s: Who chaired the Fourteenth Finance Commission?
nf5f4c8b11ad.x: Y.V. Reddy chaired the 14th FC; Rangarajan the 12th, Kelkar the 13th and N.K. Singh the 15th.

neddc1526032.s: Under the Fourteenth Finance Commission, income distance carried a weight of:
neddc1526032.x: The 14th FC gave 50% to income distance, 17.5% to 1971 population, 10% to 2011 population and 15% to area.

n2ee7c4a83e6.s: The 15th Finance Commission was mandated to use the population data of which Census?
n2ee7c4a83e6.x: Its terms of reference required 2011 population data, and also covered disaster-management financing and a non-lapsable defence fund.

nindian-economy-50-1.s: Who chaired the Fifth Finance Commission (1968)?
nindian-economy-50-1.x: Mahaveer Tyagi chaired the 5th FC (1968); K.C. Neogy chaired the 1st (1951) and K.C. Pant the 10th (1992).

n7bdac9b3758.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission, local bodies receive grants of about:
n7bdac9b3758.x: Of total grants of ₹9.47 lakh crore, local bodies get ₹7.91 lakh crore (rural 4.35, urban 3.56).

n5b2859e5bd5.s: The 16th Finance Commission raised the weight of population to:
n5b2859e5bd5.x: Population weight was raised to 17.5% and a GDP criterion was added; all five southern States saw their shares rise.

nf9738a9553b.s:
Assertion (A): The 80th Constitutional Amendment, 2000 gave effect to the Tenth Finance Commission's 'Alternative Scheme of Devolution'.
Reason (R): The 80th Amendment made only income tax and corporation tax shareable with States.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf9738a9553b.x: A is true: the 80th Amendment implemented the 10th FC's 29% Alternative Scheme. R is false: it made all central taxes shareable, effective 1 April 1996.

n804ad45b650.s: Which of the following Centre-to-State transfers is untied?
n804ad45b650.x: Tax devolution under Article 270 is untied; Article 282 grants are discretionary and CSS generally need a matching State share.

n8f0bd9146be.s: The 15th Finance Commission's revenue-deficit, sector-specific and State-specific grants totalled about:
n8f0bd9146be.x: The 15th FC's grants totalled about ₹10.1 lakh crore, against ₹9.47 lakh crore under the 16th FC.

o: Statutory grants recommended by the Finance Commission
Discretionary, mostly tied and routed through Union ministries
Charged on the Consolidated Fund of India
Untied transfers from the divisible pool
nb07dfc3d075.x: Article 282 grants are discretionary, mostly tied and scheme-based; Article 275 grants are statutory and charged on the CFI.

n3625fa4e6c1.s: The 16th Finance Commission gave 'contribution to GDP' a weight of:
n3625fa4e6c1.x: GDP contribution got a 10% weight, criticised for rewarding size rather than need; the tax-effort criterion (2.5% under the 15th FC) was dropped.

n65eca4c8f81.s: Recommendations of the Finance Commission are:
o: Binding on the Union and the States
Advisory and not binding on the Government
n65eca4c8f81.x: FC recommendations are not binding on the Government; it may also deal with matters referred by the President.

n25d658858d5.s: Which of the following is excluded from the divisible pool of Union taxes?
n25d658858d5.x: Cesses and surcharges are excluded from the divisible pool, as is the cost of collection; pool taxes are shared under Article 270.

n306a94a0560.s: The 16th Finance Commission retained the States' share in the divisible pool at:
n306a94a0560.x: It retained 41 per cent; the demand of 18 of 28 States for 50 per cent was not accepted.

n41ee428f5fd.s: The Finance Commission is constituted by the President every:
n41ee428f5fd.x: The quasi-judicial FC is constituted every fifth year or earlier; its recommendations are advisory.

n694fff9f899.s: The Gadgil formula was introduced in:
n694fff9f899.x: The Gadgil formula dates to 1969; formula-based plan transfers lapsed when NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission on 1 January 2015.

n5b1664525e3.s: Which of the following was among the initial Special Category States under the Gadgil formula?
n5b1664525e3.x: The initial Special Category States were Assam, Jammu and Kashmir, and Nagaland.

nc45024ea5ce.s: Article 275 grants are NOT generally meant for:
o: Welfare of Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Areas
nc45024ea5ce.x: Article 275 grants support revenue deficits, local bodies, disasters and tribal welfare, not every CSS.

n5bfa15c2ecb.s:
Assertion (A): There is no separate State Finance Commission for Municipalities.
Reason (R): Under Article 243Y, the State Finance Commission constituted under Article 243I also reviews municipal finances.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n5bfa15c2ecb.x: The same SFC constituted by the Governor under 243I reviews municipal finances under 243Y, which is why no separate SFC exists.

na5ca68e3cd8.s: Which of the following is a non-tax revenue source of urban local bodies?
na5ca68e3cd8.x: Rents, fees and fines are non-tax revenues; professional and advertisement taxes are tax revenues.

nf60390dc4a8.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission's local-body grants, the basic grant forms:
nf60390dc4a8.x: The basic grant is 80% (half tied, half untied); the 20% performance grant is fully untied.

nf378db617c2.s: Drone maps under which scheme can give panchayats a property-tax baseline?
nf378db617c2.x: SVAMITVA drone maps provide a property-tax baseline; AMRUT 2.0 incentivises property-tax reform and municipal bonds.

n6f712e933b0.s: Panchayats, being constrained in their power to tax, depend substantially on:
n6f712e933b0.x: Panchayats depend substantially on grants; gram sabhas spend only about 4% of their time on revenue generation.

nee95eddd965.s: The one-time Urbanisation Premium is associated with:
o: Merging peri-urban villages under a Rural-to-Urban Transition Policy
nee95eddd965.x: The premium is tied to merging peri-urban villages and adopting a Rural-to-Urban Transition Policy.

n75e618e1c9b.s: Which of the following is NOT an entry condition for local bodies under the 16th Finance Commission framework?
o: Properly constituted and elected local body
Timely constitution of the State Finance Commission
n75e618e1c9b.x: The entry conditions are elected bodies, online audited accounts and timely SFCs; municipal-bond issuance is not one.

nindian-economy-46-4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Capital expenditure – directed toward creation or acquisition of assets
Revenue deficit – revenue receipts minus revenue expenditure
Revenue expenditure – involves no creation of assets
Non-plan expenditure – included subsidies, interest payments and defence
nindian-economy-46-4.x: Revenue deficit is revenue expenditure minus revenue receipts, not the reverse.

n41a138632c5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about effective capital expenditure in BE 2026-27?
o: Grants-in-aid for creation of capital assets account for ₹4.93 lakh crore of it
It is estimated at 101.1 per cent of the fiscal deficit
It excludes grants-in-aid for creation of capital assets
Grants to States are revenue expenditure even when used to create assets
n41a138632c5.x: Effective capital expenditure includes grants-in-aid for creation of capital assets.

n0c098895c86.x: Subsidies are revenue expenditure; grants to States are also revenue expenditure, while defence equipment purchase can be capital outlay.

n210b7bb88f4.s: The Oil Pool Account under the Administered Price Mechanism was dismantled in:
n210b7bb88f4.x: It was dismantled in April 2002; later OMC under-recoveries were compensated through oil bonds.

n3852ec9ef0e.s: Who chaired the Expenditure Management Commission of 2014?
n3852ec9ef0e.x: Bimal Jalan chaired the 2014 Expenditure Management Commission and also, separately, the RBI Economic Capital Framework committee (2018-19).

nfac63eb62b5.s: The Sixteenth Finance Commission's approach to subsidies favoured:
o: Well-targeted subsidies with exclusion criteria and sunset clauses
nfac63eb62b5.x: It supported well-targeted subsidies with exclusion criteria and sunset clauses, not unrestricted off-budget financing.

n800210c7c13.s: Stepwise increases in public expenditure caused by wars and crises (the displacement effect) are explained by:
n800210c7c13.x: Peacock-Wiseman explains discontinuous rises through crises; Wagner's law links continuous growth of spending to industrialisation.

na3ca1b987b5.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Reserve Bank of India – Banker to the Centre and States under the RBI Act, 1934
Public Debt Office – Issue, servicing and records of G-Secs
Public Debt Management Cell – Set up in 2016 within the RBI
Department of Economic Affairs – Debt strategy and external borrowing
na3ca1b987b5.x: The PDMC was set up in 2016 in the Department of Economic Affairs, headed by the Joint Secretary (Budget), not within the RBI.

na59d32874de.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the interest-growth differential?
o: When the effective interest rate exceeds nominal GDP growth, the debt-GDP ratio falls even with a primary deficit
The differential is r − g, where g is nominal GDP growth
When g exceeds r, the debt-GDP ratio can fall even with a small primary deficit
When r exceeds g, a primary surplus is needed
na59d32874de.x: When r exceeds g, a primary surplus is needed to stabilise debt; the ratio does not fall with a primary deficit.

ndd755ee3d1b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about public debt management in India?
o: The PDMC was set up in 2016 in the Department of Economic Affairs
The statutory PDMA has been created and has taken over the RBI's Public Debt Office
The PDMC is headed by the Joint Secretary (Budget)
A statutory PDMA was first proposed in Budget 2015-16
ndd755ee3d1b.x: The statutory PDMA has not yet been created; the RBI still manages public debt.

n054772542e4.s: Special securities issued to the National Small Savings Fund form part of the Centre's:
n054772542e4.x: NSSF securities, like saving and compensation bonds and 14-day intermediate T-Bills, are non-marketable internal debt.

n67ca165f9a7.s: Household bank deposits reach government borrowing mainly through banks':
n67ca165f9a7.x: Bank deposits flow to government borrowing through SLR holdings, alongside small savings/NSSF and insurance and provident funds.

nindian-economy-62-13.s: Short-term government debt instruments are called:
nindian-economy-62-13.x: Treasury Bills are short-term; G-Secs are long-term and SDLs are issued by States.

n1afcd7c7394.s: The FRBM Act, as amended in 2018, set the Centre's debt target for 2024-25 at:
n1afcd7c7394.x: General government debt was set at 60% with the Centre at 40%, as the N.K. Singh Committee recommended (States 20%).

n2c64195ff31.s: Since 2005-06, external loans to States have been:
n2c64195ff31.x: External loans reach States only through the Centre, on a back-to-back basis for general category States.

n8d9aabdb36e.s: Internal debt constitutes what share of India's public debt?
n8d9aabdb36e.x: Internal debt is 96.7% of public debt; G-Secs are over 90% of Central Government debt.

nc0d34023d62.s: Most of India's external debt is owed by:
o: Non-sovereign borrowers such as companies and banks
nc0d34023d62.x: Most external debt is non-sovereign; the Government's external debt is only about 2.6% of GDP.

n52c73264e6c.s: The FRBM framework caps new Central government guarantees at ____ of GDP a year.
n52c73264e6c.x: New Central guarantees, treated as contingent liabilities, are capped at 0.5% of GDP a year.

nindian-economy-59-7.s: Which is the main account of the Government of India?
nindian-economy-59-7.x: The Consolidated Fund is the main account and receives loan recoveries; the Public Account holds trust money.

nindian-economy-62-9.s: Public debt is classified into internal and external debt on the basis of the:
nindian-economy-62-9.x: Internal and external debt are distinguished by where the government borrows from.

n077444164f7.s: Andhra Pradesh's fiscal deficit in 2024–25 was:
n077444164f7.x: AP's 2024–25 fiscal deficit of 5.05 per cent exceeded the 4 per cent ceiling; market loans form 75 per cent of its debt.

n0cf0df1dd7c.s: Heavy government market borrowing that raises interest rates and squeezes private investment is called:
n0cf0df1dd7c.x: Absorbing loanable funds and squeezing private investment is crowding out; borrowing to pay interest is the debt trap.

n0eb48d797f9.s: In Indian usage, deficit financing means meeting the budget gap by:
o: Borrowing from the RBI, which creates new money
n0eb48d797f9.x: In India, deficit financing means borrowing from the RBI and creating new money; Western usage covers any financing of a deficit.

n73547215809.s: When the FRBM escape clause is invoked, the deviation from the fiscal target is capped at:
n73547215809.x: The escape-clause deviation is capped at 0.5% of GDP a year; since 2018 monetised borrowing is allowed only on escape-clause grounds.

n3169246d4ae.s: Ways and Means Advances (WMA) came into operation from:
n3169246d4ae.x: WMA began on 1 April 1997 after the March 1997 agreement ended ad hoc T-bills, whose phase-out began in September 1994.

nad1d033cc41.s: Which method of deficit financing is the most inflationary?
nad1d033cc41.x: Creation of new money is most inflationary, followed by bank and then public borrowing; debt repayment withdraws money.

n3f9152e5a89.s: India's reliance on deficit financing became heavier from which period onwards?
n3f9152e5a89.x: Deficit financing was used in a limited way until the late 1960s and relied on more heavily from the 1970s onwards.

nd68326b4e05.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the relationship between deficits?
o: Primary deficit equals fiscal deficit minus interest payments
The effective revenue deficit is always greater than the revenue deficit
Fiscal deficit exceeds revenue deficit when capex exceeds non-debt capital receipts
Effective revenue deficit equals revenue deficit minus grants for creation of capital assets
nd68326b4e05.x: Since ERD = RD minus grants for creation of capital assets, ERD is less than or equal to RD.

nindian-economy-21-4.s: Fiscal deficit minus interest payments gives the:
nindian-economy-21-4.x: Primary deficit = fiscal deficit − interest payments; revenue deficit = revenue expenditure − revenue receipts.

nffeb27e426e.s: Resource mobilisation, equitable distribution and balanced regional development are objectives of:
nffeb27e426e.x: Economic growth, equitable distribution, resource mobilisation and balanced regional development are all objectives of fiscal policy.

n8cdc5e5e55a.s: Monetary policy can act relatively quickly because the MPC takes decisions:
n8cdc5e5e55a.x: The MPC decides bi-monthly, whereas fiscal policy works through the slower budget cycle.

nd62d299ff9d.s: In Musgrave's budget functions, providing public goods and allocating resources is the:
nd62d299ff9d.x: Allocation means providing public goods; distribution reduces inequality and stabilisation controls inflation and unemployment.

n37003dfac58.s: Which deficit indicates government borrowing for day-to-day consumption?
n37003dfac58.x: Revenue deficit shows borrowing for consumption; fiscal deficit shows the total borrowing requirement from all sources.

n92e776aeaa8.s: India's fiscal deficit declined from 9.2 per cent to ____ per cent during its fiscal consolidation.
n92e776aeaa8.x: The decline from 9.2 to 4.4 per cent was linked to three sovereign rating upgrades in 2025 by Morningstar DBRS, S&P and R&I.

n90512fb6d5a.s: Which way of financing a deficit may expose the economy to currency risk?
n90512fb6d5a.x: External borrowing creates currency risk; RBI financing creates money and public borrowing absorbs liquidity.

n27ba001c92f.s: Who popularised the term 'fiscal federalism' in 1959?
n27ba001c92f.x: Richard Musgrave popularised fiscal federalism in 1959 and identified allocation, distribution and stabilisation as budget functions.

ncf96498bdbc.s: A zero primary deficit means the government borrows only to:
ncf96498bdbc.x: Zero PD means FD equals interest payments, so borrowing only services past debt, a debt-trap signal.

n822ce9894bf.s: From 1 April 1997, ad hoc Treasury Bills were replaced by:
n822ce9894bf.x: Ad hoc T-bills, which meant automatic monetisation, were replaced by WMA; an overdraft is only use of WMA beyond the limit.

n44282143bce.s: Which of the following is NOT an instrument of fiscal policy?
n44282143bce.x: The repo rate is a monetary policy tool of the RBI/MPC; the others are fiscal tools of the Government.

na87dad76f99.s: Tax concessions and cheap credit are examples of:
na87dad76f99.x: Tax concessions and cheap credit can constitute hidden subsidies.

n4e3bf107af3.s: A government has a fiscal deficit of ₹1,50,000 crore and interest payments of ₹1,20,000 crore. Its primary deficit is:

n776b1953fba.s: From 2006-07, the FRBM framework bars the RBI, in normal times, from:
o: Subscribing to primary issues of Government securities
Acting as banker to the States
n776b1953fba.x: The RBI cannot subscribe to primary issues of G-Secs except under the escape clause.

n6c4ada0bd2f.s: A fiscal stance that runs deficits in recessions and consolidates in booms is called:
n6c4ada0bd2f.x: Counter-cyclical policy runs deficits in slumps (e.g. Atma Nirbhar Bharat, 2020); pro-cyclical policy deepens volatility.

n6be3c9268c6.s: Use of Ways and Means Advances beyond the permitted limit is called:
n6be3c9268c6.x: WMA are temporary RBI advances for cash mismatches; using them beyond the limit is an overdraft.

nad0a0df0d1c.s: A higher fiscal deficit can widen the current account deficit because government dissaving:
o: Reduces national savings and widens the savings-investment gap
nad0a0df0d1c.x: Lower national savings widen the savings-investment gap, which may be met by foreign capital, widening the CAD.

ncf0e536984b.s: The newer debt anchor targets debt of ____ of GDP by 2031.
ncf0e536984b.x: The new anchor is 50 ± 1 per cent by 2031, criticised as tolerating more debt than the 40 per cent associated with FRBM.

n440a83f0e00.s: With regard to fiscal discipline, States generally operate under:
o: The Union FRBM Act, applied identically
Rules framed by the Finance Commission
n440a83f0e00.x: States have their own fiscal responsibility Acts; the Union FRBM framework does not automatically apply to them.

n4224e6a9d24.s: The Sixteenth Finance Commission described State fiscal rules as:
n4224e6a9d24.x: It called State fiscal rules 'effectively unenforced' and sought a wider deficit definition covering off-budget borrowing.

n59940fda81a.s: The N.K. Singh FRBM Review Committee recommended which indicator as the principal fiscal anchor?
n59940fda81a.x: Debt-to-GDP was the principal anchor and fiscal deficit the operational target, with general government debt at 60% by 2023.

nfd4b9262c65.s: Under the original FRBM Act, 2003, the fiscal deficit was to be brought down to 3% of GDP by:
nfd4b9262c65.x: FD was to reach 3% by 31 March 2008; the revenue deficit was to be eliminated by 31 March 2009.

nb64424eed15.s: During COVID-19 in 2020–21, India's fiscal deficit was recorded at:
nb64424eed15.x: The fiscal deficit reached 9.2 per cent of GDP in 2020–21, after which targets were recalibrated with a gradual return path.

nbeccb2f84ec.s: The 2004 Task Force on Implementation of the FRBM Act was chaired by:
nbeccb2f84ec.x: Vijay Kelkar chaired it and recommended tax reform and a comprehensive GST; he later headed the Thirteenth FC.

ne1b566ac340.s: Under the Fifteenth Finance Commission, the net borrowing limit for States in 2022-23 was:
ne1b566ac340.x: The limits were 4% in 2021-22, 3.5% in 2022-23, and 3% from 2023-24 to 2025-26 plus 0.5% for power-sector reforms.

n56f409ad521.s: The Medium-Term Fiscal Policy Statement sets ____ rolling targets.
n56f409ad521.x: It sets three-year rolling targets for revenue deficit, fiscal deficit, a tax-GDP indicator and total outstanding liabilities.

n32fa00bc111.s: Under the buoyancy clause of the 2018 FRBM amendment, a sharp rise in real output growth requires the fiscal deficit to fall by at least:
n32fa00bc111.x: The buoyancy clause requires at least a 0.25% of GDP cut in the fiscal deficit; it never permits an automatic increase.

nb7680ee2661.s: The FRBM Act, 2003 was introduced by Finance Minister:
nb7680ee2661.x: Yashwant Sinha introduced the FRBM Act; its Rules came into force on 5 July 2004.

n5802e51028d.s: When the FRBM escape clause is invoked, the Government must place before Parliament:
o: A justification and a path back to the target
An RBI approval for the deviation
n5802e51028d.x: The Government must justify the deviation (capped at 0.5% of GDP) and lay a path back to the target before Parliament.

nc2df4070c15.s: Who presented the first Budget in India in 1860?
nc2df4070c15.x: James Wilson presented India's first Budget in 1860; R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented free India's first Budget in 1947.

n0b2dfd78d1b.s: Which of the following is NOT a ground for invoking the FRBM escape clause?
o: Sharp fall in real output growth
Routine tax shortfall due to administrative delay
n0b2dfd78d1b.x: Grounds include national security, war, calamity, agricultural collapse, structural reforms and a sharp output fall, not routine administrative delays.

nbf89557895d.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Plan/non-plan distinction – Replaced by revenue/capital classification from 2010-11
Development expenditure – Education, health, employment and industry
Non-development expenditure – Defence, police, interest and administration
Committed expenditure – Defence spending with little scope for cuts
nbf89557895d.x: The plan/non-plan distinction was replaced by revenue/capital classification from 2017-18.

n93af811d35c.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: James Wilson – First budget of India, 7 April 1860
Liaquat Ali Khan – Presented the most budgets (10)
R.K. Shanmukham Chetty – First budget of independent India, 26 November 1947
n93af811d35c.x: Liaquat Ali Khan presented the 1947-48 Interim Government budget; Morarji Desai presented the most budgets (10).

nindian-economy-48-6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: A revenue receipt neither creates a liability nor reduces assets
Disinvestment is a capital receipt that reduces assets
Treasury Bills are a long-term domestic borrowing instrument
Foreign loans are capital receipts from external borrowing
nindian-economy-48-6.x: Treasury Bills are short-term domestic borrowing instruments.

n968cf08669b.s:
Assertion (A): Demands for Grants include revenue expenditure, capital expenditure and loans.
Reason (R): Charged expenditure is not shown separately in the Demands for Grants.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n968cf08669b.x: A is true: Demands for Grants (Article 113) cover revenue, capital and loan components. R is false: charged items are shown separately.

n4c9d137347f.s: In the Union Budget 2026-27, the fiscal deficit was estimated at:
n4c9d137347f.x: The FD was 4.3% of GDP, with expenditure of ₹53,47,315 crore and debt at 55.6 per cent.

n5953f3f07b6.s: The salaries of the CAG and UPSC members are charged expenditure, which means they are:
n5953f3f07b6.x: Charged expenditure, such as for presiding officers, UPSC and CAG, is discussable but not voted.

n97914b3449b.s: Which of the following is an example of charged expenditure?
n97914b3449b.x: Interest on public debt is charged expenditure: non-votable but discussable, and shown separately in appropriation.

n046c31a766b.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the Appropriation Bill?
n046c31a766b.x: Article 114 covers the Appropriation Bill; 112 is the Annual Financial Statement, 113 the estimates, 115 supplementary grants.

nbb4a0378d0e.s: The 1997-98 Union Budget is known as the:
nbb4a0378d0e.x: 1997-98 was the Dream Budget, while 1973-74 was the Black Budget.

n7aabf88022e.s: The Annual Financial Statement is provided for under Article:
n7aabf88022e.x: Article 112 provides for the Annual Financial Statement; the Constitution does not use the word 'Budget'.

nfa7a4fe7cea.s: In Budget 2026-27, the largest item of 'rupee goes to' was:
o: States' share of taxes and duties
nfa7a4fe7cea.x: The States' share (22 paise) was the largest outflow, ahead of interest (20 paise); borrowings (24 paise) were the largest source.

nce9c2755377.s: Recovery of loans is classified as a:
nce9c2755377.x: Recovery of loans is a non-debt capital receipt; market borrowings are debt capital receipts.

n880d53b3df9.x: ZBB is linked to Peter Pyhrr and was first used in government by Jimmy Carter; the Hoover Commission is linked to performance budgeting.

ne1c01bde94a.s: Voting on Demands for Grants takes place in:
o: A joint sitting of both Houses
ne1c01bde94a.x: General discussion is in both Houses, but Demands for Grants are voted only in the Lok Sabha.

neeb71617fef.s: Cut motions on the Budget are moved at the stage of:
neeb71617fef.x: Cut motions come at the voting on demands; the general discussion has no cut motions or voting.

nb9a4e47ff82.s: The revised estimate of the fiscal deficit for 2024-25 was:
nb9a4e47ff82.x: RE 2024-25 was 4.8 per cent, higher than the 4.4 per cent BE for 2025-26.

nb35766b952c.s: A budget in which receipts equal expenditure is called a:
nb35766b952c.x: A balanced budget has receipts equal to expenditure; a surplus budget curbs inflation but may slow growth.

n040999cfa53.s: A cut motion that seeks to reduce a demand to Re 1 is called a:
n040999cfa53.x: A policy cut reduces the demand to Re 1; an economy cut reduces it by a stated amount and a token cut by Rs 100.

n776eba82eb2.s: The Public Account of India is provided for under Article:
n776eba82eb2.x: The Public Account is under Article 266(2); withdrawals need no appropriation since the government acts only as banker.

nc3b399d33d0.s: The word 'Budget' comes from the French word 'bougette', meaning:
nc3b399d33d0.x: 'Bougette' means 'little bag'; Budget printing begins with the Halwa ceremony at North Block.

n0d2f3a1aee2.s: No money can be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund of India without:
n0d2f3a1aee2.x: Withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund (Article 266) needs an Appropriation Act; a vote on account authorises advance spending.

n02f85189d3c.s: Under the erstwhile Plan/non-Plan classification, interest payments were classified as:
n02f85189d3c.x: Plan expenditure covered Central Plans and central assistance for State/UT Plans; interest was non-Plan.

n86cdc5da4b3.s: The Union Budget 2026-27 was billed as a:
n86cdc5da4b3.x: It was billed as a 'Yuva Shakti-driven Budget', presented by Nirmala Sitharaman on 1 February 2026 with three Kartavyas.

nfc674947bf0.s: A Vote on Account is provided for under Article:
nfc674947bf0.x: Article 116 provides for a Vote on Account, usually for two months; it is still used in election years.

n19b37c207fc.s: Budgeting that links outlays to measurable outcomes is called:
n19b37c207fc.x: Outcome budgeting links outlays to outcomes; performance budgeting links spending to activities.

n70a884788c2.s: The combined fiscal deficit of the States in FY25 rose to:
n70a884788c2.x: It rose to 3.2 per cent in FY25; 18 States exceeded the 15th FC's 3 per cent limit in FY24.

nindian-economy-32-5.s: Dividends and profits from government enterprises are:
nindian-economy-32-5.x: Dividends and profits are revenue receipts; land, machinery and loans to States are capital payments.

nindian-economy-46-6.s: Salaries, pensions and statutory transfers were classified as:
nindian-economy-46-6.x: Maintenance of infrastructure, salaries, pensions and statutory transfers were all non-plan expenditure.

nindian-economy-45-4.x: Disinvestment is a capital receipt that reduces assets; salaries and allowances are revenue expenditure.

n9c9920cfa13.s: Along with the end of the Plan/non-Plan classification, the Union Budget began to be presented on:
n9c9920cfa13.x: The Railway Budget was merged with the Union Budget and the Budget was presented on 1 February.

nindian-economy-48-5.s: Which of the following is a revenue receipt?
nindian-economy-48-5.x: Interest receipts are revenue receipts, like tax revenue, dividends/profits and fees; the others are capital receipts.

nff1e535ec6b.s: As the principal instrument of fiscal policy, the Union Budget performs the functions of:
o: Regulation of banks and financial markets
Resource allocation, income redistribution and stabilisation
nff1e535ec6b.x: The Budget allocates resources, redistributes income and stabilises the economy.

nc993502c82d.s: The Gender Budget Statement has been presented in India since:
nc993502c82d.x: Output-Outcome budgeting and the Gender Budget Statement date from 2005-06; performance budgeting began in the late 1960s on ARC advice.

n5fea2ef5291.s: The new Income-tax Act, 2025 becomes effective from:
n5fea2ef5291.x: It takes effect from 1 April 2026; Budget 2026-27 made no slab change and cut MAT from 15% to 14%.

nf521d354954.s: Which of the following gives effect to the tax proposals of the Union Budget?
nf521d354954.x: The Finance Bill gives effect to tax proposals; the Appropriation Bill authorises withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund.

n7db6d534486.s:
Assertion (A): The 'Twin Balance Sheet' problem (Economic Survey 2016-17) refers to over-leveraged corporates and stressed banks together choking private capex.
Reason (R): Hidden NPAs were exposed by the RBI Asset Quality Review of 2019.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n7db6d534486.x: A is true; R is false because the Asset Quality Review that exposed hidden NPAs was in 2015. The response was the IBC and bank recapitalisation.

nb5c7812d07d.s: The climate chapter of the Economic Survey 2025-26, given scarce fiscal resources, favoured:
o: Near-term emission cuts over development spending
Diverting health funds to emission cuts
nb5c7812d07d.x: It favoured adaptation and argued against diverting resources from health, agriculture and poverty reduction; it called civilisational collapse unlikely.

na1cd7457b00.s: The Economic Surveys 2018-19 to 2020-21 are associated with:
na1cd7457b00.x: K.V. Subramanian: 2018-19 to 2020-21; Arvind Subramanian: 2014-15 to 2017-18; Sanyal: 2021-22; Nageswaran: 2022-23 to 2025-26.

nb4fce6fbfff.s: Presentation of the Economic Survey before the Union Budget is:
o: A requirement under the FRBM Act
nb4fce6fbfff.x: It is only a convention; Article 112 concerns the Annual Financial Statement.

ne186f7f37a8.s: The Economic Survey 2025-26 placed real GDP growth for FY26 (First Advance Estimates) at:
ne186f7f37a8.x: FY26 growth was 7.4% (FAE); FY27 was projected at 6.8%-7.2% and potential growth raised to 7.0% from 6.5%.

n167bda9547f.s: In place of inspection, the Economic Survey 2025-26 favoured:
n167bda9547f.x: It favoured trust-based compliance, a shift from control to enabling, and held process reforms more important than policy reforms.

nca19a794311.s: Deregulation was the central theme of the Economic Survey:
nca19a794311.x: Deregulation was the central theme of ES 2024-25; ES 2023-24 spoke of 'letting go' and lighter MSME inspections.

n396e43bd8d3.s: The Economic Survey 2025-26 treated India's high foreign exchange cover as:
n396e43bd8d3.x: High forex cover was reported as an external strength; the Survey's concerns were State revenue deficits and unconditional cash transfers.

n520343728b6.s: Public capital expenditure proposed for FY 2026-27 under the Viksit Bharat @2047 framework is:
n520343728b6.x: Public capex of ₹12.2 lakh crore is proposed for FY 2026-27, with infrastructure as the growth pillar.

n12ec85bf320.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025-26, the repo rate was cut since February 2025 by:
n12ec85bf320.x: Repo was cut by 125 bps; banks' gross NPAs fell to a multi-decade low of 2.2%.

n1f00a3739fc.s: The Economic Survey has been presented separately from the Union Budget since:
n1f00a3739fc.x: The first Survey was for 1950-51, but it has been presented separately from the Budget only since 1964.

n4d27dff561f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the sectoral structure of Andhra Pradesh and India?
o: Industry forms a larger share of AP's GVA than of India's
Agriculture and allied formed 35.29% of AP's GVA in 2024–25
Agriculture's share in AP is about twice India's share
Services formed about 54% of India's GVA and 41.53% of AP's
n4d27dff561f.x: Industry's share was 23.18% in AP, lower than India's 27.6%.

nc3d3375210c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's Zero Poverty-P4 initiative?
o: Well-off Margadarsis adopt poor Bangaru Kutumbam families
Its nodal body, the Swarna Andhra P4 Foundation, is under the Fisheries Department
It was launched on Ugadi, 30 March 2025
nc3d3375210c.x: The Swarna Andhra P4 Foundation is under the Planning Department, not Fisheries.

n917bf45bf69.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the districts of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The latest number of districts is 28
Undivided AP had 20 districts on 1 November 1956
The reorganisation of 4 April 2022 raised the number to 26

n61be65f63a0.s:
Assertion (A): By GVA in 2024-25, Railways and Communications were the two smallest services sub-sectors of Andhra Pradesh.
Reason (R): Communications was the slowest-growing services sub-sector in 2025-26 (FAE).
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n61be65f63a0.x: A is true. R is false: Communications, though small, was the fastest-growing services sub-sector in 2025-26 (15.13%).

ne73446c3555.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh's GSDP estimates are compiled by the National Statistical Office.
Reason (R): State Domestic Product is the value of all goods and services produced within the State in a year, counted without duplication.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ne73446c3555.x: A is false: AP's GSDP is compiled by the State Directorate of Economics & Statistics. R correctly defines SDP.

n6a242738df0.s: Among the targets set for 2047, per capita income is to exceed:
n6a242738df0.x: The 2047 targets are per capita income above $42,000, skilled workforce above 95%, exports above $450 billion and renewable share above 75%.

n3636e80bcef.s: How many districts does the Aspirational Districts Programme cover?
n3636e80bcef.x: The programme covers 112 districts, including Vizianagaram in AP; the Backward Regions Grant Fund is now defunct.

n310680efac2.s: Which was the top-performing services sub-sector in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?
n310680efac2.x: Communications led in 2025-26 at 15.13%; banking and insurance grew 14.25% in 2024-25.

nd0d5f48d51d.s: Andhra Pradesh ranks ____ among Indian States in GSDP.
nd0d5f48d51d.x: AP is 8th by GSDP, 10th by population (4.09%), and has the 3rd longest coastline (1,053.07 km).

n9688c9cb7f5.s: In 2025-26, Andhra Pradesh ranked first in India in:
n9688c9cb7f5.x: AP ranked first in SHG-bank linkage and third in MGNREGS employment in 2025-26.

n4db21e03ebe.s: Andhra Pradesh accounts for about what share of India's area?
n4db21e03ebe.x: AP has about 4.96% of India's area (about 1,62,970 sq km) and 4.09% of its population.

n6dc784485f0.s: Which of the following contributed to residuary Andhra Pradesh becoming a chronic revenue-deficit State?
o: Inheritance of the IT and industrial assets
Transfer of power-sector deficits to Telangana
n6dc784485f0.x: The loss of Hyderabad's revenue base, a large agrarian population, and liabilities for irrigation and power deficits made residuary AP revenue-deficit.

n5fb0ae104ec.s: In the classification of Andhra Pradesh's GVA, construction is a sub-sector of:
n5fb0ae104ec.x: Industry has four sub-sectors: mining, manufacturing, electricity-gas-water supply and construction.

n0643c2aeb68.s: In SES 2025-26 (FAE), Andhra Pradesh's GSDP at constant 2011-12 prices grew by:
n0643c2aeb68.x: Constant-price growth was 9.88% and current-price growth 10.75% in 2025-26 (FAE).

nae87b9ef0c6.s: Andhra Pradesh's Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26, not tabled in the Budget Session, was released on:
nae87b9ef0c6.x: It came out on 12 April 2026; its FAE put AP's growth at 9.88%, above India's 7.4%.

ne661bc57f1a.s: Services account for about what share of Andhra Pradesh's GVA?
ne661bc57f1a.x: Services form about 43% of AP's GVA, lower than India's 52.9%.

n5753384183f.s: Andhra Pradesh's debt-GSDP ratio in 2024-25 RE was about:
n5753384183f.x: Debt was 35.15% of GSDP; capital outlay rose from ₹16,141 crore to ₹33,135 crore and 370 loans were restructured.

n10959143db0.s: Andhra Pradesh supplies about ____ of India's farm output.
n10959143db0.x: AP supplies about 10% of India's farm output; the 2024-25 Survey targets 30% agri growth over five years via 17 growth engines.

n91734a77f3f.s: In the 2011-12 base series, Andhra Pradesh's constant-price GSDP growth peaked at 12.16% in:
n91734a77f3f.x: The constant-price peak was 12.16% in 2015-16 and the low 1.52% in 2020-21.

n6bc9f68fb0b.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh has the highest MPI headcount?
n6bc9f68fb0b.x: Kurnool has the highest headcount (12.84%) and West Godavari the lowest (2.42%); AP's 6.06% is below India's 14.96%.

n6bde8d53232.s: Andhra Pradesh's draft Population Management Policy 2026 proposes an incentive for a second or third child of:
n6bde8d53232.x: It proposes ₹25,000, removal of the two-child norm for local polls, and records AP's TFR as 1.5.

ne259e0ecdd2.s: Which was the fastest-growing industrial sub-sector in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 (FAE)?
ne259e0ecdd2.x: Construction grew fastest at 14.18%; industry grew 9.15%, mining 7.88% and manufacturing 7.03%.

ndc83e04bba8.s: Casual labour forms what share of rural workers in Andhra Pradesh?
ndc83e04bba8.x: Casual labour is 33.8% in AP, above India's 22.5%; regular wage/salaried workers are 13.7%.

nc800a2dd9b2.s: Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India's tobacco exports with a share of:
nc800a2dd9b2.x: AP is first in tobacco exports (67%) and second in raw silk after Karnataka; it is 7th in milk.

n21eefcd5b53.s: In 2024-25 (FAE), Andhra Pradesh's agriculture sector grew by:
n21eefcd5b53.x: Agriculture grew 10.70% in 2024-25, ahead of industry (6.58%) and services (8.53%).

n254f99598ee.s: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 is guided by:
n254f99598ee.x: It is guided by Ten Sutras, aligned with Viksit Bharat 2047, aiming at a 'Wealthy, Healthy and Happy' AP.

n32dfd2a1b6c.s: The AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 provides a special development package for how many backward districts?
n32dfd2a1b6c.x: The package covers seven districts: three of North Coastal Andhra and four of Rayalaseema.

n051a6ab6f6b.s: Andhra Pradesh, first in fruit production, contributes about what share of India's fruit output?
n051a6ab6f6b.x: AP ranks first in fruits with 15.6% of national output and third in horticulture GVA.

na5253e82eaa.s: Compared with India, Andhra Pradesh's growth from 2024-25 onwards was:
na5253e82eaa.x: AP grew more slowly than India in 2023-24 but faster from 2024-25 onwards.

nc6302f25817.s: India's new GDP series released by MoSPI uses the base year:
nc6302f25817.x: India's new series uses 2022-23, while AP's Survey tables continue with 2011-12.

n2f35e701040.s: Andhra Pradesh, with 8,555 bank branches, had a credit-deposit ratio of:
n2f35e701040.x: AP's CD ratio was 157.4%, with several districts above 200%.

na63a0fbc56b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about district development monitoring in Andhra Pradesh?
o: District Vision Action Plans are tracked at district, constituency and mandal levels
District Domestic Product is compiled by the National Statistical Office
Collectors are rated on investment and jobs
Collectors are rated on the rise in district per capita income
na63a0fbc56b.x: District Domestic Product is compiled by the State Directorate of Economics and Statistics.

n07ac5a771dd.s: Per capita income in the Survey is based on:
n07ac5a771dd.x: PCI uses NSDP, which is net of depreciation, at current or constant prices.

nd13550b6926.s: The National Income Committee (1951) estimated India's per capita income for 1948-49 at:
nd13550b6926.x: It put PCI for 1948-49 at ₹225; AP's PCI rose from ₹7,781 in 1960 to about ₹2.07 lakh in 2021-22.

n8b646134ff8.s: In 2024-25, Telangana's per capita income was how many times Andhra Pradesh's?
n8b646134ff8.x: It was 1.35 times in 2024-25, up from 1.3 times in 2013-14 and 6% higher in 2004-05.

n663a725333a.s: Andhra Pradesh's per capita income growth in 2025-26 was:
n663a725333a.x: AP's PCI grew 10.43% against India's 6.9%; AP's PCI stayed above the national average throughout.

n2c011a24170.s: Rayalaseema accounts for about what share of Andhra Pradesh's horticulture output?
n2c011a24170.x: Drought-prone Rayalaseema has 43% of AP's horticulture area and 52% of its output.

ne047dfdf40a.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission's income-distance criterion, Andhra Pradesh's above-average per capita income:
o: Has no effect on its share
ne047dfdf40a.x: A higher PCI means a smaller income distance, lowering AP's share; the criterion carries 42.5% weight.

nab65bed1149.s: Per capita income rises only when national income grows:
o: At the same rate as population
nab65bed1149.x: PCI = income / population, so it rises only if income grows faster than population.

nad0fc5251ac.s: Per capita income alone cannot fully show economic well-being mainly because it:
o: Is measured only at constant prices
Is compiled only once a decade
Is an average that conceals inequality and cost-of-living differences
nad0fc5251ac.x: Being an average, PCI hides inequality and ignores cost-of-living variation.

n0f05fc999f7.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: only a ranking, no dates)
n0f05fc999f7.s: Among Telangana, Karnataka, Haryana and Tamil Nadu, which had the highest per capita income in 2022-23?
n0f05fc999f7.x: The order was Telangana (₹3.54 lakh), Karnataka (₹3.44 lakh), Haryana and Tamil Nadu (₹3.09 lakh).

nb94b383912a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding per capita GSDP and per capita income?
o: Per capita GSDP and PCI are interchangeable terms
PCI is NSDP divided by population
Per capita GSDP is a gross measure
Gross measures should be compared with gross measures
nb94b383912a.x: They are not interchangeable: per capita GSDP is gross, while PCI is based on net NSDP.
